note: DF (0.5.1 follow-up, Kina's `${this.api}`): an endpoint base held in a class member assigned from config - a one-return getter `get apiUrl() { return environment.apiUrl; }`, a readonly field `base = `${environment.apiUrl}/notifications``, or `environment.apiUrl.replace('/api', '') + '/admin'` - reaches the URL as `${this.apiUrl}`, which the TS parser keeps as an opaque `${…}` and the endpoint fold cannot look up (the const table has no `this.<member>` key). HEAD (84e2e71, leap wheel): ENDPOINTs `endpoint:GET:${…}/trades`, `${…}/unread`, `${…}/users`, `${…}/stats`, paired only through the HTTP resolver's base (suffix) tier, and `${…}/stats` pairs the PUBLIC `GET /stats`, not `GET /admin/stats` (a wrong-service pair). A module-level `export const ADMIN_BASE = environment.apiUrl.replace('/api', '') + '/admin'` is no const-table binding either (constants.rs binds literal values only). Kina a448fb3: 89 of 150 ENDPOINT_HIT sites keep a `${…}` base - this.adminBase 29, this.base 27, ADMIN_BASE 16, this.api 13, and 4 `process.env.X || lit` BACKEND sites in two demo scripts; [endpoint-fold] folded 57; [http] paired=93 (exact=48 base=45). The 42 `${this.apiUrl}` sites already fold, only because the const table's last-segment fallback reads `this.apiUrl` as environment.apiUrl's `apiUrl`.
